summary: Both r1 rulings applied (commit 64a500f). P2 now watches every scope folder under the remote that holds declaring backups, whatever the credential store says, and limits each refresh to one listing per scope folder plus reads of metadata files it has not seen before. P6 adds the operator runbook for the backup alerts with the scope-retirement step; V07 is updated, V20 and V21 added, and the dry-run parses all seven phases.
